removal.note: shub repo remove-member then carol GET /v1/repos/alice/secdemo → 403; bob still 200. The untrusted host serves no plaintext tree route at all (router_local_ui only), so membership is checked on a host-served endpoint. Crypto S2 also covered by IntervalDkr forward-block decrypt denial unit test.

fork_detection.note: Injected broken prev_head_hash into server tip/log; timed sh repo verify.

cas_conflict.note: Two concurrent sit push from divergent checkouts; client CAS retries up to 8.

consolidation.note: After Remove: sh repo rotate then sh repo consolidate (CommittingAead under safehub-v1:consol, 12 MiB tip budget). Full-history rewrite of all superseded ciphertext remains optional if lag is allowed.

force_push_policy.note: ML-DSA-87 admin co-sig accept + missing-cosig reject (safehub-client policy tests).

invite_path.note: Control-plane invite + durable OpenMLS Welcome (device KP publish → invite → accept-welcome) timed when harness succeeds.

scenarios.name: Malicious-host fork / tip equivocation
scenarios.analogue: Forge serves divergent branch tips (cf. historical VCS tip tampering)
scenarios.mechanism: Encrypted RefHead hash chain + sh repo verify + ML-DSA leaf sig

scenarios.name: Removed member + server collusion
scenarios.analogue: Ex-collaborator retains forge ACL (cf. overprivileged owner)
scenarios.mechanism: Membership revoke → HTTP 403; DKR forward-block decrypt denial (unit)

scenarios.name: Forward-only / CI history containment
scenarios.analogue: Contractor/CI must not read pre-join history
scenarios.mechanism: DKR history window + grafted forward-only invite + durable Welcome

scenarios.name: Force-push without admin co-signature
scenarios.analogue: Unauthorized history rewrite (cf. PHP git incident class)

scenarios.name: Concurrent push / CAS rollback race
scenarios.mechanism: Server CAS on H(head) + client retry (≤8)

scenarios.name: Post-Remove honest-storage rewrite
scenarios.mechanism: Immediate rotate + sh repo consolidate tip rewrite

scenarios.name: Stale tip / rollback to old seq
scenarios.analogue: Server serves older tip to partitioned clients

notes: Primary size_ops: full-stack E2E sit:// localhost (sh auth + sit push/fetch/clone) with ML-DSA-87 leaf RefHead signatures.
Storage overhead = ciphertext_store_bytes_approx / fixture_bytes (git bundle compresses).
Join sweep: OpenMLS Category-5 grow; durable multi-device Welcome timed in invite_path.
Scenarios S1–S7: measured timings republished (S4 = ML-DSA admin cosig policy).
Consolidation: rotate + sh repo consolidate (honest-storage tip rewrite under consol AEAD).
Simulated-WAN and per-size membership costs: see scripts/e2e_additive_scale.sh.
